  SELECT school_id
  FROM schools
  WHERE charter_number = 756 AND LOWER(mailing_city) = 'san diego'
),
sat_counts AS (
  SELECT s.school_id,
         COALESCE(ss.num_sat_test_takers, 0) AS num_sat_test_takers

)

WITH operating_high_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    s.school_name,
    s.nces_id,
    s.low_grade_served,
    s.high_grade_served,
    s.low_grade_offered,
    s.high_grade_offered,
    s.enroll_grade_12,
    s.status
  FROM schools s
  WHERE
    s.nces_district_id = '0613360'
    AND s.status = 'Currently operating'
    AND (s.high_grade_served = 12 OR s.enroll_grade_12 > 0)
    AND s.enroll_grade_12 > 0
),
sat_counts AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(sc.num_takers), 0) AS total_takers
  FROM operating_high_schools s
  LEFT JOIN satscores sc ON s.school_id = sc.school_id
  GROUP BY s.school_id
),
eligible_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    s.school_name,
    s.low_grade_served,
    s.high_grade_served
  FROM operating_high_schools s
  JOIN sat_counts sat ON s.school_id = sat.school_id
  WHERE sat.total_takers = 0
    AND s.enroll_grade_12 > 0
)
SELECT
  es.school_name,
  es.low_grade_served,
  es.high_grade_served
FROM eligible_schools es
JOIN (
  SELECT MIN(CASE 
               WHEN low_grade_served = 'Preschool' THEN 0
               WHEN low_grade_served = 'Kindergarten' THEN 1
               WHEN low_grade_served GLOB 'Grade *' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(low_grade_served, 7) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE 100
             END) AS min_start_grade
  FROM eligible_schools
) min_g
ON (CASE 
      WHEN es.low_grade_served = 'Preschool' THEN 0
      WHEN es.low_grade_served = 'Kindergarten' THEN 1
      WHEN es.low_grade_served GLOB 'Grade *' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(es.low_grade_served, 7) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE 100
    END) = min_g.min_start_grade
ORDER BY es.school_name ASC;

WITH state_board_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    s.name AS school_name,
    s.mailing_street,
    s.mailing_city,
    s.mailing_state,
    s.mailing_zip
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.district_type = 'State Board'
    AND s.directly_run = 1
),
school_reading_scores AS (
  SELECT
    sc.school_id,
    AVG(sa.reading_score) AS avg_reading_score
  FROM satscores sa
  JOIN schools sc ON sa.school_id = sc.school_id
  WHERE sc.district_type = 'State Board'
    AND sc.directly_run = 1
  GROUP BY sc.school_id
)
SELECT
  sbs.school_name,
  sbs.mailing_street || ', ' || sbs.mailing_city || ', ' || sbs.mailing_state || ' ' || sbs.mailing_zip AS full_mailing_address,
  srs.avg_reading_score
FROM state_board_schools sbs
JOIN school_reading_scores srs ON sbs.school_id = srs.school_id
WHERE srs.avg_reading_score = (
  SELECT MAX(avg_reading_score)
  FROM school_reading_scores
)
ORDER BY sbs.school_name

SELECT
  SchoolName,
  [School Type],
  Latitude
FROM schools
WHERE
  (
    -- School type includes "Middle" (case-insensitive) or "Junior High" or "Intermediate"
    LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%middle%' OR
    LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%junior high%' OR
    LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%intermediate%'
    OR
    -- School name includes "Middle" (case-insensitive) or "Junior High" or "Intermediate"
    LOWER(SchoolName) LIKE '%middle%' OR
    LOWER(SchoolName) LIKE '%junior high%' OR
    LOWER(SchoolName) LIKE '%intermediate%'
  )
  AND Latitude IS NOT NULL
  AND StateAbbr = 'CA'
  -- only schools physically located in California
  -- include both open and closed
  -- no other exclusion criteria
  -- to exclude anything not meant as schools (admin offices etc), assume only those with latitude
)
AND Latitude = (
  SELECT MAX(Latitude)
  FROM schools
  WHERE
    (
      LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%middle%' OR
      LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%junior high%' OR
      LOWER([School Type]) LIKE '%intermediate%'
      OR
      LOWER(SchoolName) LIKE '%middle%' OR
      LOWER(SchoolName) LIKE '%junior high%' OR
      LOWER(SchoolName) LIKE '%intermediate%'
    )
    AND Latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND StateAbbr = 'CA'
)
ORDER BY SchoolName

WITH active_charters AS (

    s.cds,
    s.schoolname,
    s.charter_funding_type,
    s.status,

    s.k12enrollment_2014_15
  FROM schools s

    AND s.status = 'Active'
),
sat_combined_scores AS (
  SELECT
    ss.cds,
    (COALESCE(ss.sat_reading_avg,0) + COALESCE(ss.sat_math_avg,0) + COALESCE(ss.sat_writing_avg,0)) AS total_sat
  FROM satscores ss
  WHERE ss.sat_reading_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.sat_math_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.sat_writing_avg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ac.charter_funding_type AS funding_category,
  COUNT(*) AS num_active_schools,
  SUM(COALESCE(ac.k12enrollment_2014_15,0)) AS total_k12_enrollment_2014_15,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(ac.free_reduced_percent,0)), 2) AS avg_pct_eligible_free_reduced_meals,
  ROUND(AVG(satcs.total_sat), 2) AS avg_combined_sat_score
FROM active_charters ac
LEFT JOIN sat_combined_scores satcs ON ac.cds = satcs.cds
GROUP BY ac.charter_funding_type
ORDER BY ac.charter_funding_type

WITH ca_special_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.schoolcode,
        s.name,
        s.grspan,
        s.k12enr
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.state = 'CA'
      AND s.type = 'State Special Schools'
      AND s.ay = 2015
),
-- Extract the earliest grade from grspan; assume format like 'K-12', 'P-8', '1-12', etc.
parsed AS (
    SELECT
        css.schoolcode,
        css.name,
        css.k12enr,
        -- Extract the first part of grspan
        CASE
            WHEN instr(css.grspan, '-') > 0 THEN substr(css.grspan, 1, instr(css.grspan, '-') - 1)
            ELSE css.grspan
        END AS min_grade
    FROM ca_special_schools css
),
grade_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        -- To determine which grade comes later, give increasing rank to P=0, K=1, 1=2, 2=3, ..., 12=13, etc.
        CASE
            WHEN min_grade = 'P' THEN 0
            WHEN min_grade = 'K' THEN 1
            WHEN min_grade GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(min_grade AS INTEGER) + 1
            ELSE 99 -- for unrecognized codes, deprioritize
        END AS grade_order
    FROM parsed p
),
max_grade AS (
    SELECT
        g.*
    FROM grade_ranked g
    WHERE (g.grade_order, g.k12enr, g.name) IN (
        SELECT
            grade_order,
            MAX(k12enr) AS max_enr,
            MIN(name) AS min_name
        FROM grade_ranked
        WHERE grade_order = (SELECT MAX(grade_order) FROM grade_ranked)
        GROUP BY grade_order
    )
    -- If there is a tie in k12enr, pick first alphabetically by name.
    ORDER BY g.name ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
sat_counts AS (
    SELECT
        s.schoolcode,
        COUNT(ss.studentid) AS sat_takers
    FROM satscores ss
    JOIN schools s ON ss.schoolcode = s.schoolcode
    WHERE s.ay = 2015
    GROUP BY s.schoolcode
)
SELECT
    m.name AS school_name,
    m.min_grade AS earliest_grade_level,
    m.k12enr AS k12_enrollment,
    COALESCE(sc.sat_takers, 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM max_grade m
LEFT JOIN sat_counts sc ON m.schoolcode = sc.schoolcode
;

WITH county_charter_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.school_id,
        s.charter_funding_type,
        s.school_status,
        s.school_type,
        s.district_type
    FROM
        schools s
    WHERE
        s.school_type = 'Charter' 
        AND s.district_type = 'County Office of Education'
        AND s.charter_funding_type IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
        AND s.school_status = 'Active'
),
meal_data AS (
    SELECT
        f.school_id,
        SUM(f.k12_enrollment) AS total_k12_enrollment,
        SUM(f.k12_frpm_eligible) AS total_k12_frpm_eligible
    FROM
        frpm f
    GROUP BY
        f.school_id
)
SELECT
    ccs.charter_funding_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.school_id) AS num_currently_operating_schools,
    COALESCE(SUM(md.total_k12_enrollment), 0) AS total_k12_enrollment,
    COALESCE(SUM(md.total_k12_frpm_eligible), 0) AS total_frpm_eligible
FROM
    county_charter_schools ccs
LEFT JOIN
    meal_data md ON ccs.school_id = md.school_id
GROUP BY
    ccs.charter_funding_type
ORDER BY
    CASE ccs.charter_funding_type
        WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END
;

WITH closed_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.name,
    s.district,
    s.county,
    sa.avg_writing
  FROM
    schools s
    JOIN satscores sa ON s.cdscode = sa.cdscode
  WHERE
    s.status = 'Closed'
    AND sa.avg_writing IS NOT NULL
),
score_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_writing DESC) as score_rank
  FROM
    closed_schools
)
SELECT
  name,
  district,
  county,
  avg_writing
FROM
  score_ranks
WHERE
  score_rank = 2;

FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores t

WHERE s.state = 'CA'
  AND s.status = 'Active'
  AND s.instruction_level = 'High School'

WITH target_county AS (
  SELECT county_name
  FROM schools
  WHERE cds_code = '1612590125716'
  LIMIT 1
),
filtered_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.cdscode,
    s.county_name,
    s.school_name,
    s.charter,
    f.free_meals,
    f.frpm_meals,
    f.enrolled as frpm_enrolled,
    ROUND(CAST(f.free_meals AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(f.enrolled,0) * 100, 2) AS free_meal_pct,
    ROUND(CAST(f.frpm_meals AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(f.enrolled,0) * 100, 2) AS frpm_meal_pct
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
  WHERE
    s.county_name = (SELECT county_name FROM target_county)
    AND f.stat_type = 'All'
    AND f.enrolled > 0
    AND s.school_type IN ('HS', 'MS', 'ES', 'K-12', 'K-8', '7-12', '6-12') -- assuming K-12 covers all
    AND f.free_meals > 500
    AND f.frpm_meals < 700
)
SELECT
  fs.county_name,
  COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(fs.free_meal_pct),2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(fs.frpm_meal_pct),2) AS avg_frpm_meal_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fs.charter = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter_schools,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fs.charter = 'N' OR fs.charter IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_charter_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(sat.total_score),2) AS avg_sat_score
FROM
  filtered_schools fs
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    cdscode,
    ROUND(sat_critical_reading_avg_score + sat_math_avg_score + sat_writing_avg_score, 2) AS total_score
  FROM satscores
  WHERE sat_critical_reading_avg_score IS NOT NULL
    AND sat_math_avg_score IS NOT NULL
    AND sat_writing_avg_score IS NOT NULL
) sat
  ON fs.cdscode = sat.cdscode
GROUP BY
  fs.county_name
;

SELECT 
    SUM(open_monthly.count) / 12.0 AS avg_schools_per_month_1980
FROM (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', opened) AS ym,
        COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM schools
    WHERE 
        county = 'San Diego'
        AND type = 'Public'
        AND district_id IS NOT NULL
        AND strftime('%Y', opened) = '1980'
    GROUP BY ym

    UNION ALL

    -- Ensure months with zero openings are included
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS ym,
        0 AS count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            date('1980-01-01', '+' || (n || ' month')) AS date
        FROM (
            SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL 
            SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL 
            SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL 
            SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
        )
    )
    WHERE ym NOT IN (
        SELECT 
            strftime('%Y-%m', opened)
        FROM schools
        WHERE 
            county = 'San Diego'
            AND type = 'Public'
            AND district_id IS NOT NULL
            AND strftime('%Y', opened) = '1980'
    )
) AS open_monthly;

WITH ca_highmath AS (
  SELECT s.code
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sat ON s.code = sat.school_code
  WHERE s.state = 'CA' AND sat.sat_math_avg > 400
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN virtual != 'Not offered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS virtual_count
  FROM schools
  WHERE code IN (SELECT code FROM ca_highmath)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * virtual_count / total, 1) AS percentage_virtual
FROM counts;

WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.school_code,
        s.school_name,
        s.GSserved,
        s.CharterYn,
        frpm.frpm_rate
    FROM
        schools s
        JOIN frpm ON s.school_code = frpm.school_code
    WHERE
        s.county_name = 'Alameda'
        AND (
            -- School serves 12th grade if GSserved ends with '12', (e.g. '9-12', '6-12', 'K-12')
            trim(substr(GSserved, -2)) = '12'
        )
),
max_rate AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(frpm_rate) AS highest_frpm_rate
    FROM
        eligible_schools
)
SELECT
    es.school_name,
    ROUND(es.frpm_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE
        WHEN es.CharterYn = 'Y' THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN es.CharterYn = 'N' THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS charter_school,
    es.GSserved AS grades_served,
    CASE
        WHEN ss.reading_average IS NULL AND ss.math_average IS NULL AND ss.writing_average IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        ELSE
            CASE
                WHEN (
                    COALESCE(ss.reading_average, 0) + COALESCE(ss.math_average, 0) + COALESCE(ss.writing_average, 0)
                )/(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN ss.reading_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE 
                        WHEN ss.math_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE 
                        WHEN ss.writing_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                )
                >= (
                    SELECT AVG(
                        COALESCE(reading_average, 0) + COALESCE(math_average, 0) + COALESCE(writing_average, 0)
                    ) / (
                        CASE WHEN reading_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                        CASE WHEN math_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                        CASE WHEN writing_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    )
                    FROM satscores
                    WHERE (reading_average IS NOT NULL OR math_average IS NOT NULL OR writing_average IS NOT NULL)
                )
                + (
                    SELECT 
                        CASE 
                            WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN 
                                sqrt(avg(((
                                    COALESCE(reading_average,0) + COALESCE(math_average,0) + COALESCE(writing_average,0)
                                ) / (
                                    CASE WHEN reading_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                                    CASE WHEN math_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                                    CASE WHEN writing_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                )) 
                                - (
                                    SELECT AVG(
                                        COALESCE(reading_average, 0) + COALESCE(math_average, 0) + COALESCE(writing_average, 0)
                                    ) / (
                                        CASE WHEN reading_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                                        CASE WHEN math_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                                        CASE WHEN writing_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                    )
                                    FROM satscores
                                    WHERE (reading_average IS NOT NULL OR math_average IS NOT NULL OR writing_average IS NOT NULL)
                                )
                                ) * (
                                    (
                                    COALESCE(reading_average,0) + COALESCE(math_average,0) + COALESCE(writing_average,0)
                                    ) / (
                                    CASE WHEN reading_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                                    CASE WHEN math_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                                    CASE WHEN writing_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                    )
                                )
                            )) 
                        ELSE 0 END
                    FROM satscores
                    WHERE (reading_average IS NOT NULL OR math_average IS NOT NULL OR writing_average IS NOT NULL)
                )
                THEN 'Above Average'
                WHEN (
                    COALESCE(ss.reading_average, 0) + COALESCE(ss.math_average, 0) + COALESCE(ss.writing_average, 0)
                )/(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN ss.reading_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE 
                        WHEN ss.math_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE 
                        WHEN ss.writing_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                )
                <= (
                    SELECT AVG(
                        COALESCE(reading_average, 0) + COALESCE(math_average, 0) + COALESCE(writing_average, 0)
                    ) / (
                        CASE WHEN reading_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                        CASE WHEN math_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                        CASE WHEN writing_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    )
                    FROM satscores
                    WHERE (reading_average IS NOT NULL OR math_average IS NOT NULL OR writing_average IS NOT NULL)
                )
                - (
                    SELECT 
                        CASE 
                            WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN 
                                sqrt(avg(((
                                    COALESCE(reading_average,0) + COALESCE(math_average,0) + COALESCE(writing_average,0)
                                ) / (
                                    CASE WHEN reading_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                                    CASE WHEN math_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                                    CASE WHEN writing_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                )) 
                                - (
                                    SELECT AVG(
                                        COALESCE(reading_average, 0) + COALESCE(math_average, 0) + COALESCE(writing_average, 0)
                                    ) / (
                                        CASE WHEN reading_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                                        CASE WHEN math_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                                        CASE WHEN writing_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                    )
                                    FROM satscores
                                    WHERE (reading_average IS NOT NULL OR math_average IS NOT NULL OR writing_average IS NOT NULL)
                                )
                                ) * (
                                    (
                                    COALESCE(reading_average,0) + COALESCE(math_average,0) + COALESCE(writing_average,0)
                                    ) / (
                                    CASE WHEN reading_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                                    CASE WHEN math_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                                    CASE WHEN writing_average IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                    )
                                )
                            )) 
                        ELSE 0 END
                    FROM satscores
                    WHERE (reading_average IS NOT NULL OR math_average IS NOT NULL OR writing_average IS NOT NULL)
                )
                THEN 'Below Average'
                ELSE 'Average'
            END
    END AS sat_performance
FROM
    eligible_schools es
    JOIN max_rate mr ON es.frpm_rate = mr.highest_frpm_rate
    LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON es.school_code = ss.school_code

WITH eligible_schools AS (

        s.MailingZip,

        s.OpenDate,
        s.CloseDate,
        CASE WHEN s.CloseDate IS NULL THEN 'open' ELSE 'closed' END AS status
    FROM schools s
    LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        (s.SchoolType = 'Regular' OR s.SchoolType = 'High')  -- targeting regular public schools; include 'High' if used
        AND (s.CharterYN IS NULL OR s.CharterYN = 'N')
        AND s.K12Enrollment > 100
)
, sat_stats AS (
    SELECT
        CDSCode,
        AVG(ReadingMean + MathMean + WritingMean) AS avg_total_sat,
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN (ReadingMean + MathMean + WritingMean) >= 1500 THEN NumTook ELSE 0 END) / 
            NULLIF(SUM(NumTook),0) AS pct_sat_1500_or_more
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumTook > 0
    GROUP BY CDSCode
)
, largest_frpm_count AS (
    SELECT
        es.*,
        ss.avg_total_sat,
        ss.pct_sat_1500_or_more,
        'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS which_part
    FROM eligible_schools es
    LEFT JOIN sat_stats ss ON es.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode
    WHERE es.frpm_eligible IS NOT NULL
      AND es.frpm_eligible = (SELECT MAX(frpm_eligible) FROM eligible_schools)
)
, smallest_frpm_share AS (
    SELECT
        es.*,
        ss.avg_total_sat,
        ss.pct_sat_1500_or_more,
        'smallest FRPM share' AS which_part
    FROM eligible_schools es
    LEFT JOIN sat_stats ss ON es.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode
    WHERE es.frpm_share IS NOT NULL
      AND es.frpm_share = (SELECT MIN(frpm_share) FROM eligible_schools)
)
, specific_cds AS (
    SELECT
        es.*,
        ss.avg_total_sat,
        ss.pct_sat_1500_or_more,
        'the CDS code from my notes' AS which_part
    FROM eligible_schools es
    LEFT JOIN sat_stats ss ON es.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode
    WHERE es.CDSCode = '4615150435602'
)
SELECT
    which_part,
    SchoolName,
    County,
    City,
    MailingStreet,
    MailingCity,
    MailingState,
    MailingZip,
    Website,
    K12Enrollment,
    frpm_eligible,
    ROUND(frpm_share, 4) AS frpm_share,
    ROUND(avg_total_sat, 1) AS avg_total_sat,
    ROUND(pct_sat_1500_or_more, 2) AS pct_sat_1500_or_more,
    OpenDate,
    status
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM largest_frpm_count
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM smallest_frpm_share
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM specific_cds
)
ORDER BY 
    CASE which_part 
        WHEN 'largest FRPM-eligible count' THEN 1
        WHEN 'smallest FRPM share' THEN 2
        WHEN 'the CDS code from my notes' THEN 3
        ELSE 4 END,
    SchoolName;

WITH filtered_cards AS (
  SELECT c.card_types
  FROM cards c
  INNER JOIN foreign_data f ON c.id = f.card_id
  WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
)
, type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    TRIM(type) AS type, 
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM filtered_cards,
    -- Split the card_types field into individual types assuming it's a comma-separated string
    -- Substitute appropriate split method if it's a different separator or structure
    LATERAL (
      SELECT value AS type
      FROM (
        SELECT substr(card_types, start+1, end-start-1) AS value
        FROM (
          SELECT 0 AS start
          UNION ALL
          SELECT instr(card_types || ',', ',', pos + 1)
          FROM (
            SELECT instr(card_types || ',', ',', 1) AS pos, card_types
            FROM filtered_cards
            UNION ALL
            SELECT instr(card_types || ',', ',', instr(card_types || ',', ',', 1) + 1), card_types
            FROM filtered_cards
            WHERE instr(card_types || ',', ',', 1) > 0
          )
        ) bounds
        JOIN (
          SELECT ',' || card_types || ',' AS card_types
          FROM filtered_cards
        ) cards
        ON start < length(card_types) AND (end := instr(card_types || ',', ',', start+1))
      )
      WHERE value <> ''
    )
  GROUP BY TRIM(type)
)
, max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt FROM type_counts
)
SELECT type, cnt
FROM type_counts
WHERE cnt = (SELECT max_cnt FROM max_count)
ORDER BY type;

  ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS avg_age
FROM user_upvotes
WHERE age IS NOT NULL;

WITH answers_per_question AS (
    SELECT
        p.id AS question_id,
        COUNT(a.id) AS answer_count
    FROM posts p
    LEFT JOIN posts a ON a.parentId = p.id AND a.postTypeId = 2
    WHERE p.postTypeId = 1
    GROUP BY p.id
),
linked_questions AS (
    SELECT
        pl.relatedPostId AS question_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', pl.creationDate) AS link_month
    FROM postLinks pl
    JOIN posts q ON pl.relatedPostId = q.id AND q.postTypeId = 1
    WHERE strftime('%Y', pl.creationDate) = '2010'
),
filtered_questions_linked AS (
    SELECT
        lq.link_month,
        lq.question_id
    FROM linked_questions lq
    JOIN answers_per_question apq
        ON lq.question_id = apq.question_id
    WHERE apq.answer_count <= 2
    GROUP BY lq.link_month, lq.question_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(month_count * 1.0), 2) AS avg_posts_with_link_and_max_two_answers
FROM (
    SELECT
        m.month,
        COUNT(fql.question_id) AS month_count
    FROM (
        SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', d) AS month
        FROM (
            SELECT date('2010-01-01', '+' || (n || '') || ' months') AS d
            FROM (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
                UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9
                UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11)
        )
    ) m
    LEFT JOIN filtered_questions_linked fql ON fql.link_month = m.month
    GROUP BY m.month
)
;

WITH posts_2010 AS (
  SELECT id, ownerUserId
  FROM posts
  WHERE strftime('%Y', creationDate) = '2010' AND score > 5 AND ownerUserId IS NOT NULL
),
high_rep_users AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM users
  WHERE reputation >= 1000
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN p.ownerUserId NOT IN (SELECT id FROM high_rep_users) THEN 1 END) 
    / COUNT(*), 2
  ) AS percentage_non_high_rep
FROM posts_2010 p;

WITH target_post AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM posts
  WHERE title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
  LIMIT 1
),
edit_comments AS (
  SELECT ph.userid, u.displayname, COUNT(*) AS num_edit_comments
  FROM postHistory ph
  JOIN target_post tp ON ph.postid = tp.id
  JOIN users u ON ph.userid = u.id
  WHERE ph.comment IS NOT NULL AND ph.comment != ''
  GROUP BY ph.userid, u.displayname
)
SELECT displayname, num_edit_comments
FROM edit_comments
WHERE num_edit_comments = (SELECT MAX(num_edit_comments) FROM edit_comments)
ORDER BY displayname;

WITH customer_2012_tx AS (
    SELECT
        t.customer_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_consumption
    FROM
        transactions_1k t
    WHERE
        t.transaction_date >= '2012-01-01'
        AND t.transaction_date < '2013-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        t.customer_id
),
small_customers AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.client_segment
    FROM
        customers c
        INNER JOIN customer_2012_tx tx ON c.customer_id = tx.customer_id
    WHERE
        tx.total_consumption < 30000
)
SELECT
    client_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS num_small_customers
FROM
    small_customers
GROUP BY
    client_segment
ORDER BY
    num_small_customers DESC;

SELECT 
    c.client_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS active_cardholders_2013
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE 
    t.product_type = 'fuel'
    AND strftime('%Y', t.transaction_date) = '2013'
GROUP BY 
    c.client_segment

SELECT 
    CAST((JULIANDAY(MAX(t.transaction_time)) - JULIANDAY(MIN(t.transaction_time))) * 24 * 60 AS INTEGER) AS minutes_elapsed
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.gasstation_id = g.gasstation_id
WHERE g.country = 'Czech Republic'
  AND t.price > 1000

WITH months AS (
  SELECT yyyymm
  FROM yearmonth
  WHERE yyyymm BETWEEN 201301 AND 201311
),
customer_months AS (
  SELECT
    t.customer_id,
    t.currency,
    strftime('%Y%m', t.transaction_date) AS yyyymm
  FROM transactions_1k t
  WHERE strftime('%Y', t.transaction_date) = '2013'
    AND CAST(strftime('%m', t.transaction_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 11
    AND t.product_id IN (
      SELECT product_id
      FROM products
      WHERE category = 'fuel'
    )
  GROUP BY t.customer_id, t.currency, yyyymm
),
active_customers AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    currency
  FROM customer_months
  GROUP BY customer_id, currency
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT yyyymm) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM months)
)
SELECT
  currency,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS steady_active_customer_count
FROM active_customers
GROUP BY currency
HAVING steady_active_customer_count = (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS cnt
    FROM active_customers
    GROUP BY currency
  )
)

WITH q2_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        t.customer_id,
        SUM(t.litre) AS total_fuel_q2
    FROM
        transactions_1k t
    WHERE
        t.transaction_date >= '2013-04-01'
        AND t.transaction_date < '2013-07-01'
    GROUP BY
        t.customer_id
),
q2_customers AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.currency
    FROM
        customers c
    WHERE
        c.customer_id IN (
            SELECT customer_id FROM q2_transactions
        )
)
SELECT
    q2c.currency,
    ROUND(AVG(q2t.total_fuel_q2), 2) AS avg_fuel_consumed
FROM
    q2_transactions q2t
    INNER JOIN q2_customers q2c ON q2t.customer_id = q2c.customer_id
WHERE
    q2c.currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK')
GROUP BY
    q2c.currency

WITH customer_2012_totals AS (
  SELECT
    t.customer_id,
    c.currency,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_2012
  FROM transactions_1k t
  JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE strftime('%Y', t.transaction_date) = '2012'
  GROUP BY t.customer_id, c.currency
),
currency_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    currency,
    AVG(total_2012) AS avg_consumption
  FROM customer_2012_totals
  WHERE currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
  GROUP BY currency
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM currency_avgs WHERE currency = 'CZK') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM currency_avgs WHERE currency = 'EUR'), 0
  ) AS czk_minus_eur_avg_2012
;

FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
JOIN products p ON t.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.segment = 'KAM'

  AND strftime('%Y', t.txn_date) = '2013'
  AND p.product_type = 'fuel'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING SUM(t.quantity) > 1000000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS sme_customers_with_gas_purchases
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type = 'SME'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS avg_height_cm
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_3
WHERE p.height > 180

WITH young_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE birthday >= '1991-01-01'
),
defensive_rated_players AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN pa.defensive_work_rate = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_high,
           COUNT(*) AS appearances
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    INNER JOIN young_players yp ON pa.player_api_id = yp.player_api_id
    WHERE pa.defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(pa.defensive_work_rate) <> ''
    GROUP BY pa.player_api_id
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_players_with_rating,
        SUM(ever_high) AS players_ever_high
    FROM defensive_rated_players
)
SELECT
    ROUND(CAST(players_ever_high AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / total_players_with_rating, 2) AS percentage_high
FROM stats;

    pa.defensive_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.date DESC) as rn
  FROM
    Player_Attributes pa

SELECT

WITH teams_with_risky AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.team_api_id, t.short_name
  FROM Team t
  JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
  WHERE ta.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'
),
multi_short_names AS (
  SELECT short_name
  FROM teams_with_risky
  GROUP BY short_name
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT team_api_id) > 1
),
teams_on_date AS (
  SELECT 
    t.team_api_id, 
    t.short_name,
    ta.chanceCreationPassingRisk
  FROM Team t
  JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
  WHERE DATE(ta.date) <= '2014-09-19'
    AND ta.date = (
      SELECT MAX(sub_ta.date) 
      FROM Team_Attributes sub_ta 
      WHERE sub_ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id AND DATE(sub_ta.date) <= '2014-09-19'
    )
    AND t.short_name IN (SELECT short_name FROM multi_short_names)
)
SELECT 
  t.short_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) AS club_count,
  ROUND(AVG(t.chanceCreationPassingRisk * 1.0), 1) AS avg_passing_risk
FROM teams_on_date t
GROUP BY t.short_name
ORDER BY avg_passing_risk DESC, t.short_name ASC;

  SELECT
    pa.player_api_id,
    pa.defensive_work_rate,
    pa.date,
    pa.overall_rating,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.date DESC) AS rn

)
SELECT

FROM Player p
JOIN (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Latest_Player_Attributes
    WHERE rn = 1
) lpa ON p.player_api_id = lpa.player_api_id

WITH HomeClubFastBuildUpWins AS (
  SELECT
    t.team_api_id AS club_id,
    t.team_long_name AS club_name,
    t.team_short_name AS club_short_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_fast_home_big_wins
  FROM
    Match m
    JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    -- Find club's most recent Team_Attributes dated on or before this match
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        ta.team_api_id,
        ta.date,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
        -- To support window selection, select row number per (team, match)
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id ORDER BY ta.date DESC) AS rn
      FROM Team_Attributes ta
    ) ta_recent ON ta_recent.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
      AND ta_recent.date <= m.date
      -- Only consider the most recent record before match, see below where clause
  WHERE
    -- Home win by at least 3 goals
    (m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal) >= 3
    -- Only consider most recent attribute entry
    AND ta_recent.rn = 1
    -- Fast build-up play
    AND ta_recent.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
  GROUP BY
    t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
)

SELECT
  club_name,
  club_short_name,
  num_fast_home_big_wins
FROM HomeClubFastBuildUpWins
WHERE num_fast_home_big_wins = (
  SELECT MAX(num_fast_home_big_wins) FROM HomeClubFastBuildUpWins
)
ORDER BY club_name, club_short_name;

WITH season_info AS (
  SELECT 
    season, 
    id AS league_id 
  FROM League 
  WHERE name = 'Italy Serie A' 
    AND season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')
), 
season_matches AS (
  SELECT 
    M.id AS match_id, 
    S.season 
  FROM Match M
  JOIN season_info S ON M.league_id = S.league_id AND M.season = S.season
),
player_lineups AS (
  SELECT
    sm.season,
    player_id
  FROM season_matches sm
  JOIN (
    SELECT 
      id as match_id,
      home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4, home_player_5,
      home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8, home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11,
      away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4, away_player_5,
      away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8, away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
    FROM Match
  ) m
    ON sm.match_id = m.match_id
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 1 AS pos UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
  ) p1
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 'home' AS side UNION ALL SELECT 'away'
  ) p2
  -- get all 22 player ids per match via unpivot
  -- map to correct columns
  WHERE player_id = 
    CASE 
      WHEN p2.side = 'home' THEN 
        CASE p1.pos 
          WHEN 1 THEN m.home_player_1
          WHEN 2 THEN m.home_player_2
          WHEN 3 THEN m.home_player_3
          WHEN 4 THEN m.home_player_4
          WHEN 5 THEN m.home_player_5
          WHEN 6 THEN m.home_player_6
          WHEN 7 THEN m.home_player_7
          WHEN 8 THEN m.home_player_8
          WHEN 9 THEN m.home_player_9
          WHEN 10 THEN m.home_player_10
          WHEN 11 THEN m.home_player_11
        END
      ELSE 
        CASE p1.pos 
          WHEN 1 THEN m.away_player_1
          WHEN 2 THEN m.away_player_2
          WHEN 3 THEN m.away_player_3
          WHEN 4 THEN m.away_player_4
          WHEN 5 THEN m.away_player_5
          WHEN 6 THEN m.away_player_6
          WHEN 7 THEN m.away_player_7
          WHEN 8 THEN m.away_player_8
          WHEN 9 THEN m.away_player_9
          WHEN 10 THEN m.away_player_10
          WHEN 11 THEN m.away_player_11
        END
    END
    AND player_id IS NOT NULL
),
unique_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    season,
    player_id
  FROM player_lineups
)
SELECT
  season,
  COUNT(DISTINCT up.player_id) AS player_count,
  ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS avg_height_cm
FROM unique_players up
JOIN Player p ON up.player_id = p.player_api_id
GROUP BY season
ORDER BY season;

WITH latest_player_attr AS (
    SELECT
        pa.player_api_id,
        pa.height,
        pa.volley,
        pa.id,
        pa.date
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            player_api_id,
            MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) pmax ON pa.player_api_id = pmax.player_api_id AND pa.date = pmax.max_date
),
latest_per_player AS (
    SELECT
        lpa.player_api_id,
        lpa.height,
        lpa.volley
    FROM (
        SELECT
            player_api_id,
            MAX(id) AS max_id
        FROM latest_player_attr
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) m
    INNER JOIN latest_player_attr lpa
        ON lpa.player_api_id = m.player_api_id AND lpa.id = m.max_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_players
FROM latest_per_player
WHERE height > 180 AND volley > 70;

WITH Player_Home3_MatchGoals AS (
  SELECT 
    Player.player_api_id AS player_id,
    Match.id AS match_id,
    Match.home_team_goal
  FROM
    Match
    JOIN Player ON Player.player_api_id = Match.home_player_3
),
Player_Home3_GoalTotals AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    SUM(home_team_goal) AS total_goals
  FROM Player_Home3_MatchGoals
  GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_goals), 2) AS avg_home_goals_when_home3
FROM Player_Home3_GoalTotals;

WITH Player_160_or_less AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE weight <= 160
    GROUP BY player_api_id
),
PlayerAppearances AS (
    -- Gather all player IDs who appeared in a match, considering all possible fields per match
    SELECT
        m.id AS match_id,
        pa.player_api_id
    FROM Match m
    CROSS JOIN Player_160_or_less pa
    WHERE 
        pa.player_api_id IN (
            m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
            m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
            m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
            m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
        )
),
PlayerCountryAppearances AS (
    SELECT
        c.name AS country_name,
        pa.player_api_id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
    JOIN PlayerAppearances pa ON m.id = pa.match_id
    GROUP BY c.name, pa.player_api_id
),
CountryPlayerCounts AS (
    SELECT
        country_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
    FROM PlayerCountryAppearances
    GROUP BY country_name
),
MinCount AS (
    SELECT MIN(player_count) AS min_player_count
    FROM CountryPlayerCounts
)
SELECT cpc.country_name
FROM CountryPlayerCounts cpc
JOIN MinCount mc ON cpc.player_count = mc.min_player_count

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS left_foot_low_medium_attacking_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium')
  AND date <= '2015-01-01'

WITH latest_attrs AS (
  SELECT
    pa.player_id,
    pa.attacking_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.player_id ORDER BY pa.date DESC) as rn
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN la.attacking_work_rate = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
    / COUNT(*), 
    1
  ) AS percent_left_footed_low_attack_wr
FROM latest_attrs la
JOIN Player p ON la.player_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE la.rn = 1
  AND p.preferred_foot = 'left'

;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS num_players
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE jumping >= 80
  AND date >= '2007-02-22'
  AND date <= '2007-08-30';

WITH team_id AS (
  SELECT team_api_id
  FROM Team
  WHERE team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
  LIMIT 1
),
last_match AS (
  SELECT date
  FROM Match
  WHERE (home_team_api_id = (SELECT team_api_id FROM team_id)
         OR away_team_api_id = (SELECT team_api_id FROM team_id))
    AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2013'
  ORDER BY date DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT buildUpPlaySpeedClass
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE team_api_id = (SELECT team_api_id FROM team_id)
    AND date <= (SELECT date FROM last_match)
  ORDER BY date DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM latest_snapshot;

WITH date_of_interest AS (
  SELECT DATE('2013-07-12') AS dt
),
donovan AS (
  SELECT pa.overall_rating
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  JOIN date_of_interest d ON 1=1
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
    AND pa.date = d.dt
    AND pa.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
  LIMIT 1
),
players_on_date AS (
  SELECT pa.overall_rating
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  JOIN date_of_interest d ON 1=1
  WHERE pa.date = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.date)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa2
    WHERE pa2.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
      AND pa2.date <= d.dt
  )
    AND pa.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * (donovan.overall_rating - avg_players.avg_rating) / avg_players.avg_rating
    ,2
  ) AS percentage_higher
FROM donovan,
     (SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_rating FROM players_on_date) avg_players;

WITH running_loans_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  WHERE l.status = 'running'
),
districts_with_unemp AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A10_1995 AS unemp_1995, d.A10_1996 AS unemp_1996
  FROM district d
  WHERE d.A10_1995 IS NOT NULL AND d.A10_1996 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  d.district_name AS district,
  ROUND(
    (d.unemp_1996 - d.unemp_1995) / d.unemp_1995 * 100.0, 
    2
  ) AS unemployment_rate_pct_change
FROM districts_with_unemp d
WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM running_loans_accounts)
ORDER BY unemployment_rate_pct_change DESC;

WITH first_month AS (
  SELECT MIN(DATE(open_date)) AS start_date
  FROM account
),
first_month_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a, first_month fm
  WHERE DATE(a.open_date) >= fm.start_date
    AND DATE(a.open_date) < DATE(fm.start_date, '+1 month')
),
districts_with_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS population
  FROM district d
  INNER JOIN first_month_accounts fma ON d.district_id = fma.district_id
),
max_population AS (
  SELECT MAX(population) AS max_pop
  FROM districts_with_accounts
)
SELECT d.district_name, d.population
FROM districts_with_accounts d
JOIN max_population m ON d.population = m.max_pop;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions_without_purpose
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND c.birth_number BETWEEN 740101 AND 760999
  AND (t.payment_purpose IS NULL OR TRIM(t.payment_purpose) = '')

WITH loan_dates AS (
  SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount,
    l.duration,
    l.date AS approval_date,
    DATE(l.date, printf('+%d month','0')) AS start_date,
    DATE(l.date, printf('+%d month', l.duration - 1)) AS end_date,
    a.district_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
)
, active_loans AS (
  SELECT
    ld.amount,
    ld.district_id
  FROM loan_dates ld
  WHERE DATE('1995-12-31') BETWEEN ld.start_date AND ld.end_date
    AND ld.approval_date <= '1995-12-31'
)
, region_totals AS (
  SELECT
    dis.name AS region_name,
    SUM(al.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM active_loans al
  JOIN district dis ON al.district_id = dis.district_id
  GROUP BY dis.name
)
, max_total AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_amount) AS max_amount FROM region_totals
)
SELECT
  region_name,
  total_amount
FROM region_totals
WHERE total_amount = (SELECT max_amount FROM max_total);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS customer_accounts_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.district_name = 'North Bohemia'
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND t.bank = 'AB'

WITH east_bohemia_districts AS (
  SELECT A.code, A.name, A.avg_salary
  FROM district A
  WHERE A.region = 'East Bohemia'
),
branch_accounts AS (
  SELECT d.code AS district_code, a.account_id
  FROM east_bohemia_districts d
  JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.code
),
accounts_with_80s_clients AS (
  SELECT ba.district_code
  FROM branch_accounts ba
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = ba.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE substr(c.birth_number, 1, 2) BETWEEN '80' AND '89'
  GROUP BY ba.district_code
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(d.avg_salary), 2) AS avg_of_avg_salary,
  COUNT(*) AS num_districts
FROM east_bohemia_districts d
JOIN accounts_with_80s_clients ac ON d.code = ac.district_code
;

WITH central_bohemia_districts AS (
    SELECT A1.code AS district_code
    FROM district A1
    WHERE A1.name LIKE '%central Bohemia%'
),
target_clients AS (
    SELECT cl.client_id, cl.district_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
    WHERE cl.district_id IN (SELECT district_code FROM central_bohemia_districts)
      AND d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM disp d2
            JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d2.disp_id
            WHERE d2.account_id = d.account_id
        )
),
districts_of_interest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_id
    FROM target_clients
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d1.average_salary), 2) AS avg_of_avg_salary
FROM district d1
JOIN districts_of_interest d2 ON d1.code = d2.district_id
WHERE d1.average_salary IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS avg_loans_per_account
FROM (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE c.birth_number < 500101
    GROUP BY a.account_id
)

WITH male_customers_74_76 AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'M' AND birth_number BETWEEN 19740101 AND 19761231
),
customer_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE d.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM male_customers_74_76)
),
large_payments AS (
    SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.amount, t.operation, t.purpose
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM customer_accounts)
      AND t.amount > 4000
      AND t.type = 'PRIJEM' -- Only actual executed payments, not orders
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN purpose = 'household payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS household_payment_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN purpose IS NOT NULL AND purpose <> 'household payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_purpose_count
FROM large_payments
WHERE purpose IS NOT NULL
   OR purpose = 'household payment'
   OR purpose <> 'household payment'

WITH prachatice_branch_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.open_date
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
),
accounts_with_loans AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.account_id
  FROM loan l
),
borrowing_accounts AS (
  SELECT pba.account_id, pba.open_date, pba.district_id
  FROM prachatice_branch_accounts pba
  INNER JOIN accounts_with_loans awl ON pba.account_id = awl.account_id
),
account_owner_and_home_district AS (
  SELECT ba.account_id, ba.open_date, ba.district_id AS branch_district_id,
         d2.name AS home_district, d2.A3 AS home_district_population, d2.district_id AS home_district_id,
         c.client_id
  FROM borrowing_accounts ba
  JOIN disp dp ON ba.account_id = dp.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
  JOIN district d2 ON c.district_id = d2.district_id
),
total_borrowed AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
  FROM loan l
  GROUP BY l.account_id
),
bank_counterparties AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank_account) AS unique_outside_counterparties
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
    AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.bank) <> ''
    AND t.bank_account IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.bank_account) <> ''
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
final_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    aohd.account_id,
    aohd.open_date,
    COALESCE(tb.total_borrowed, 0) AS total_borrowed,
    COALESCE(bc.unique_outside_counterparties, 0) AS unique_outside_counterparties,
    aohd.home_district,
    aohd.home_district_population
  FROM account_owner_and_home_district aohd
  LEFT JOIN total_borrowed tb ON aohd.account_id = tb.account_id
  LEFT JOIN bank_counterparties bc ON aohd.account_id = bc.account_id
)
SELECT
  fa.account_id,
  fa.open_date,
  fa.total_borrowed,
  fa.unique_outside_counterparties,
  fa.home_district,
  fa.home_district_population,
  RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY CAST(fa.home_district_population AS INTEGER) DESC, fa.account_id ASC
  ) AS home_district_population_rank
FROM final_accounts fa
ORDER BY
  home_district_population_rank ASC,
  fa.account_id ASC
;

WITH gold_card_holders AS (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        c.gender,
        ca.account_id,
        ca.district_id
    FROM card cd
    JOIN disp d ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account ca ON d.account_id = ca.account_id
    WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
      AND d.type = 'OWNER'
),
account_avg_balance AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
gold_card_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        gch.client_id,
        gch.gender,
        gch.account_id,
        gch.district_id
    FROM gold_card_holders gch
    JOIN account_avg_balance aab ON gch.account_id = aab.account_id
    WHERE aab.avg_balance > 1000
),
qualified_districts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.district_name,
        d.A2 as inhabitants,
        d.A3 as avg_salary,
        d.A4 as urban_ratio
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A2 > 100000
),
target_clients AS (
    SELECT
        gca.gender,
        gca.district_id
    FROM gold_card_accounts gca
    JOIN qualified_districts qd ON gca.district_id = qd.district_id
    GROUP BY gca.gender, gca.district_id
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT
        tc.gender,
        qd.district_id,
        qd.district_name,
        qd.inhabitants,
        qd.avg_salary,
        qd.urban_ratio
    FROM target_clients tc
    JOIN qualified_districts qd ON tc.district_id = qd.district_id
),
agg_stats AS (
    SELECT
        gender,
        COUNT(DISTINCT district_id) as num_districts,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) as avg_salary,
        ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio), 2) as avg_urban_ratio
    FROM district_stats
    GROUP BY gender
),
max_inhabs AS (
    SELECT
        gender,
        MAX(inhabitants) as max_inhabitants
    FROM district_stats
    GROUP BY gender
),
most_populous AS (
    SELECT
        ds.gender,
        ds.district_id,
        ds.district_name,
        ds.inhabitants
    FROM district_stats ds
    JOIN max_inhabs mi ON ds.gender = mi.gender AND ds.inhabitants = mi.max_inhabitants
)
SELECT
    a.gender,
    a.num_districts,
    mp.district_name AS most_inhabitants_district,
    mp.inhabitants AS most_inhabitants,
    a.avg_salary,
    a.avg_urban_ratio
FROM agg_stats a
LEFT JOIN most_populous mp ON a.gender = mp.gender
WHERE a.gender IN ('F', 'M')
ORDER BY a.gender, mp.district_name

WITH gold_card_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT disp.account_id
    FROM disp
    JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
    WHERE card.type = 'gold'
),
big_city_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.population >= 250000
),
eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM gold_card_clients
    INTERSECT
    SELECT account_id
    FROM big_city_accounts
),
selected_trans AS (
    SELECT t.bank, t.account2, COUNT(*) as num_payments, SUM(t.amount) as total_amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM eligible_accounts)
      AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.date >= '1998-01-01' AND t.date <= '1998-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.bank, t.account2
),
ranked_trans AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) as rnk
    FROM selected_trans
)
SELECT bank as recipient_bank_code,
       account2 as recipient_counter_account_number,
       num_payments as outgoing_payment_count,
       total_amount
FROM ranked_trans
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY bank, account2
;

WITH pisek_branch_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.district_name = 'Pisek'
),
outgoing_payments_with_purpose AS (
    SELECT t.amount, t.k_symbol
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_branch_accounts)
      AND t.type = 'debit'
      AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
),
sipo_payments AS (
    SELECT amount
    FROM outgoing_payments_with_purpose
    WHERE k_symbol = 'SIPO'
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM sipo_payments) * 100.0 /
        NULLIF((SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM outgoing_payments_with_purpose), 0)
    ,2) AS sipo_percentage
;

WITH female_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, d.type AS disp_type, d.account_id, c.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
),
clients_with_card AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.client_id, f.account_id, f.district_id
    FROM female_clients f
    JOIN card ca ON f.client_id = ca.client_id
),
clients_with_loan AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id, account_id, district_id
    FROM female_clients
    WHERE account_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM loan)
),
target_clients AS (
    SELECT c.account_id, c.district_id
    FROM clients_with_card c
    INNER JOIN clients_with_loan l
        ON c.client_id = l.client_id
        AND c.account_id = l.account_id
),
districts_with_target_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.region, d.district_id, d.name, d.average_salary, d.unemployment_rate_95, d.unemployment_rate_96, d.no_inhabitants
    FROM district d
    JOIN target_clients t ON d.district_id = t.district_id
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        ROUND(AVG(average_salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
        ROUND(AVG(unemployment_rate_96), 2) AS avg_district_unemployment_96
    FROM districts_with_target_clients
    GROUP BY region
),
region_most_populous AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        name AS most_populous_district
    FROM (
        SELECT
            region,
            name,
            no_inhabitants,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY region
                ORDER BY no_inhabitants DESC, name ASC
            ) AS rn
        FROM districts_with_target_clients
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    rs.region,
    rs.avg_district_salary,
    rs.avg_district_unemployment_96,
    rmp.most_populous_district
FROM region_stats rs
JOIN region_most_populous rmp ON rs.region = rmp.region
ORDER BY rs.region ASC;

WITH central_bohemia_districts AS (
    SELECT code, name, inhabitants
    FROM district
    WHERE region = 'Stredni Cechy'
),
top3_central AS (
    SELECT code, name, inhabitants
    FROM central_bohemia_districts
    ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(name),'á','a'),'č','c'),'ě','e') ASC
    LIMIT 3
),
crime_1996_by_district AS (
    SELECT d.code, d.name, d.inhabitants, d.crimes_96
    FROM district d
),
top3_with_crime AS (
    SELECT t.code, t.name, t.inhabitants, c.crimes_96
    FROM top3_central t
    LEFT JOIN crime_1996_by_district c ON t.code = c.code
),
top3_avg AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(crimes_96,0)),2) AS avg_3_crime
    FROM top3_with_crime
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(crimes_96,0)),2) AS avg_all_crime
    FROM district
)
SELECT
    t.name AS district_name,
    t.inhabitants,
    t.crimes_96 AS crimes_committed_1996,
    (SELECT avg_3_crime FROM top3_avg) AS avg_crimes_top3,
    (SELECT avg_all_crime FROM overall_avg) AS avg_crimes_overall,
    ROUND((SELECT avg_3_crime FROM top3_avg) - (SELECT avg_all_crime FROM overall_avg),2) AS avg_difference
FROM top3_with_crime t
ORDER BY t.inhabitants DESC, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(t.name),'á','a'),'č','c'),'ě','e') ASC
;

WITH card_types AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT type FROM card WHERE type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
card_clients AS (
    SELECT
        c.type,
        cl.district_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.card_id = d.card_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
    WHERE c.type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
district_min_pop AS (
    SELECT
        ct.type,
        d.district_id,
        d.name AS district_name,
        d.A2 AS inhabitants
    FROM card_types ct
    JOIN card_clients cc ON ct.type = cc.type
    JOIN district d ON cc.district_id = d.district_id
),
min_inhabitants AS (
    SELECT
        type,
        MIN(inhabitants) AS min_inhabitants
    FROM district_min_pop
    GROUP BY type
)
SELECT
    dmp.type AS card_type,
    dmp.district_name,
    dmp.inhabitants
FROM district_min_pop dmp
JOIN min_inhabitants mi
    ON dmp.type = mi.type
    AND dmp.inhabitants = mi.min_inhabitants
ORDER BY dmp.type, dmp.district_name
;

WITH litomerice_region AS (
  SELECT region
  FROM district
  WHERE district_name = 'Litomerice'
  LIMIT 1
),
districts_in_region AS (
  SELECT district_id, district_name
  FROM district
  WHERE region = (SELECT region FROM litomerice_region)
),
accounts_1996 AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.district_id
  FROM account a
  WHERE a.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM districts_in_region)
    AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
    AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
account_latest_txn_1996 AS (
  -- Get, for each 1996-opened account, the txn on or before 1996-12-31 with max date, break ties by max trans_id
  SELECT t.account_id, t.trans_id, t.balance
  FROM trans t
  JOIN (
    SELECT 
      account_id,
      MAX(trans_date) as maxdate
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_1996)
      AND trans_date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
  ) mt 
    ON t.account_id = mt.account_id AND t.trans_date = mt.maxdate
  JOIN (
    -- Now, for tied trans_date, get only trans_id with the max value
    SELECT 
      t2.account_id, 
      MAX(t2.trans_id) as maxid,
      t2.trans_date
    FROM trans t2
    WHERE t2.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_1996)
      AND t2.trans_date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY t2.account_id, t2.trans_date
  ) mid
    ON t.account_id = mid.account_id AND t.trans_id = mid.maxid AND t.trans_date = mid.trans_date
),
account_1996_balances AS (
  -- Join account to their district and final 1996 balance
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    ar.district_id,
    art.balance
  FROM accounts_1996 a
  LEFT JOIN account_latest_txn_1996 art ON a.account_id = art.account_id
  LEFT JOIN districts_in_region ar ON a.district_id = ar.district_id
),
district_aggs AS (
  SELECT
    d.district_name,
    COUNT(ab.account_id) AS num_accounts_1996,
    ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS avg_end_1996_balance
  FROM districts_in_region d
  JOIN account_1996_balances ab ON d.district_id = ab.district_id
  GROUP BY d.district_name
  HAVING COUNT(ab.account_id) > 0
),
region_balance AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS region_avg_1996_balance
  FROM account_1996_balances
),
max_avg_balance_district AS (
  SELECT
    district_name,
    avg_end_1996_balance
  FROM district_aggs
  WHERE avg_end_1996_balance = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_end_1996_balance) FROM district_aggs
  )
  ORDER BY district_name ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  d.district_name,
  d.num_accounts_1996,
  d.avg_end_1996_balance,
  r.region_avg_1996_balance,
  m.district_name AS highest_avg_balance_district,
  m.avg_end_1996_balance AS highest_avg_balance
FROM
  district_aggs d
  CROSS JOIN region_balance r
  CROSS JOIN max_avg_balance_district m
ORDER BY d.district_name
;

WITH filtered_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        loan.loan_id, loan.account_id, loan.amount, loan.duration, 
        acc.district_id
    FROM loan
    JOIN account acc ON loan.account_id = acc.account_id
    WHERE loan.duration = 24
      AND acc.frequency = 'WEEKLY ISSUANCE'
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id, account_id, amount, duration, district_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY amount DESC, loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM filtered_loans
),
top10_loans AS (
    SELECT loan_id, district_id
    FROM ranked_loans
    WHERE rn <= 10
),
top_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A2 AS inhabitants, d.A3 AS average_salary
    FROM district d
    JOIN top10_loans t10 ON d.district_id = t10.district_id
),
most_populous_district AS (
    SELECT district_id, inhabitants
    FROM top_districts
    ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    mpd.district_id AS most_populous_district_id,
    mpd.inhabitants AS most_populous_inhabitants,
    ROUND(AVG(td.average_salary), 2) AS districts_avg_salary
FROM most_populous_district mpd
CROSS JOIN top_districts td
;

WITH qualified_districts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.name AS district_name, d.region, d.A2 AS population
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A2 >= 100000
),
district_withdrawals AS (
    SELECT 
        d.district_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'withdrawal' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM qualified_districts d
    JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'withdrawal'
    GROUP BY d.district_id
),
district_accounts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
    FROM qualified_districts d
    JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id
),
standing_order_debits AS (
    SELECT 
        d.district_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.type = 'debit' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_standing_order_debit
    FROM qualified_districts d
    JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN "order" o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id
)
SELECT
    qd.district_name,
    qd.region,
    qd.population,
    COALESCE(dw.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
    ROUND(COALESCE(dw.total_withdrawn,0) * 1.0 / qd.population, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(dw.total_withdrawn,0) * 1.0 / qd.population DESC) AS withdrawal_pressure_rank,
    ROUND(COALESCE(sd.total_standing_order_debit,0) * 1.0 / da.num_accounts, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM qualified_districts qd
LEFT JOIN district_withdrawals dw ON qd.district_id = dw.district_id
LEFT JOIN district_accounts da ON qd.district_id = da.district_id
LEFT JOIN standing_order_debits sd ON qd.district_id = sd.district_id
WHERE COALESCE(dw.total_withdrawn,0) > 0
ORDER BY withdrawal_pressure_rank

WITH client_home AS (
  SELECT client_id, district_id AS home_district_id
  FROM client
  WHERE client_id = 3541
),
client_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.date, a.frequency
  FROM disp d
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE d.client_id = 3541
),
account_district AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date,
    a.frequency,
    d.district_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region_name,
    d.A4 AS inhabitants,
    d.A11 AS avg_salary
  FROM client_accounts a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
home_district_name AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS home_region_name
  FROM client_home h
  JOIN district d ON h.home_district_id = d.district_id
),
is_home_district AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date,
    a.frequency,
    a.district_id,
    a.district_name,
    a.region_name,
    CASE WHEN a.district_id = h.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
    a.avg_salary,
    a.inhabitants
  FROM account_district a CROSS JOIN client_home h
),
loan_info AS (
  SELECT
    l.account_id,
    l.status AS loan_status,
    l.amount AS loan_amount
  FROM loan l
),
account_stats AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'debit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS total_expense,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS net_balance
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
region_clients AS (
  SELECT
    d.A3 AS region_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
region_most_populous AS (
  SELECT
    d.A3 AS region_name,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A4 AS inhabitants
  FROM district d
  JOIN (
    SELECT A3, MAX(A4) AS max_inhabitants
    FROM district
    GROUP BY A3
  ) x ON d.A3 = x.A3 AND d.A4 = x.max_inhabitants
),
district_population_rank AS (
  SELECT
    d1.district_id,
    d1.A3 AS region_name,
    d1.A4 AS inhabitants,
    1 + (
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d2.A4)
      FROM district d2
      WHERE d2.A3 = d1.A3 AND d2.A4 > d1.A4
    ) AS pop_rank
  FROM district d1
)
SELECT
  a.account_id,
  a.date AS account_open_date,
  a.frequency,
  a.district_name,
  a.region_name,
  a.is_home_district,
  a.avg_salary AS district_avg_salary,
  COALESCE(l.loan_status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
  COALESCE(l.loan_amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
  COALESCE(s.num_transactions, 0) AS num_transactions,
  COALESCE(s.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
  COALESCE(s.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
  COALESCE(s.net_balance, 0) AS net_balance,
  rc.num_clients AS region_home_clients,
  rmp.district_name AS region_most_populous_district,
  rmp.inhabitants AS region_most_populous_inhabitants,
  dr.pop_rank AS account_district_population_rank
FROM is_home_district a
LEFT JOIN loan_info l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_stats s ON a.account_id = s.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_clients rc ON a.region_name = rc.region_name
LEFT JOIN region_most_populous rmp ON a.region_name = rmp.region_name
LEFT JOIN district_population_rank dr ON a.district_id = dr.district_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(s.num_transactions, 0) DESC, a.account_id ASC
;

accounts_in_region AS (

account_loans AS (

per_district_year AS (

        SUM(al.total_lent) AS total_lent_in_district,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(ai.account_id) > 0 THEN

summary_by_year AS (

SELECT

WITH female_clients AS (

approved_loans AS (

),
top_loans AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM approved_loans
  WHERE amount IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT amount
    FROM approved_loans
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 3
  )
),
account_info AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id, a.district_id,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
  FROM account a

  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id
),
district_info AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.district_name, d.region, d.avg_salary
  FROM district d
),
region_loan_counts AS (
  SELECT di.region, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS region_loan_count
  FROM loan l

  JOIN district_info di ON a.district_id = di.district_id

),
region_avg_salary AS (

  FROM district_info
  GROUP BY region
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    tl.client_id,
    tl.amount AS loan_amount,
    tl.duration,
    ROUND(tl.payments * tl.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(tl.payments * tl.duration - tl.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
    tl.status AS loan_status,
    di.district_name,
    di.region,
    ai.transaction_count,
    IFNULL(ROUND(ai.total_deposits, 2), 0) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
      WHEN IFNULL(ai.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * tl.amount THEN 'High Income'
      WHEN IFNULL(ai.total_deposits, 0) > tl.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
      ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    rlc.region_loan_count,
    ras.region_avg_salary,
    -- Age calculation
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', fc.birth_date) AS INTEGER) -
      CASE
        WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', fc.birth_date) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS completed_age_on_20261009

  JOIN account_info ai ON tl.account_id = ai.account_id
  JOIN district_info di ON ai.district_id = di.district_id
  JOIN region_loan_counts rlc ON di.region = rlc.region
  JOIN region_avg_salary ras ON di.region = ras.region
)

;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    acc.account_id,
    acc.district_id
  FROM account acc
  JOIN disp d ON acc.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND c.cc_type = 'credit'
  GROUP BY acc.account_id, acc.district_id
),
branch_info AS (
  SELECT
    district.district_id,
    district.name AS district_name,
    district.region
  FROM district
),
account_totals AS (
  SELECT
    ga.account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM gold_accounts ga
  LEFT JOIN trans t ON ga.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY ga.account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ga.account_id,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS num_loans
  FROM gold_accounts ga
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON ga.account_id = l.account_id
  GROUP BY ga.account_id
),
external_counterparties AS (
  -- External counterparty = other bank in 'bank_to' or 'bank_from' not null/blank
  SELECT
    ga.account_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank_to) +
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank_from)
      - CASE 
          WHEN MIN(t.bank_to || '') = '' AND MIN(t.bank_from || '') = '' THEN 0
          ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT
              CASE
                WHEN t.bank_to != '' AND t.bank_from != '' AND t.bank_to = t.bank_from THEN t.bank_to
                ELSE NULL
              END)
        END AS num_external_counterparties
  FROM gold_accounts ga
  LEFT JOIN trans t ON ga.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE (IFNULL(t.bank_to, '') != '' OR IFNULL(t.bank_from, '') != '')
  GROUP BY ga.account_id
),
all_external_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ga.account_id,
    COALESCE(ec.num_external_counterparties, 0) AS num_external_counterparties
  FROM gold_accounts ga
  LEFT JOIN external_counterparties ec ON ga.account_id = ec.account_id
),
account_info AS (
  SELECT
    ga.account_id,
    b.district_name,
    b.region,
    at.total_received,
    at.total_withdrawn,
    lc.num_loans,
    aec.num_external_counterparties
  FROM gold_accounts ga
  JOIN branch_info b ON ga.district_id = b.district_id
  LEFT JOIN account_totals at ON ga.account_id = at.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_counts lc ON ga.account_id = lc.account_id
  LEFT JOIN all_external_counts aec ON ga.account_id = aec.account_id
),
with_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY num_external_counterparties DESC) AS account_rank
  FROM account_info
)
SELECT
  account_id,
  district_name,
  region,
  COALESCE(total_received, 0) AS total_received,
  COALESCE(total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
  COALESCE(num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
  num_external_counterparties,
  account_rank
FROM with_ranks
ORDER BY account_rank ASC, account_id
;

WITH tabor_district AS (

  WHERE D.A2 = 'Tabor'
),
owners AS (
  SELECT disp.account_id, client.client_id, client.birth_number, client.gender, MIN(account.date) AS account_opened
  FROM disp
  JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
  JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
  WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
    AND disp.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM tabor_district)
  GROUP BY disp.account_id, client.client_id, client.birth_number, client.gender
),
cards_held AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_cards
  FROM card
  WHERE issued <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
loans_held AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS num_loans,
         MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 3 WHEN status IN ('C','D') THEN 2 WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as loan_standing_int
  FROM loan
  WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_standing_label AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    num_loans,
    CASE
      WHEN num_loans = 0 THEN 'no loan'
      WHEN loan_standing_int = 3 THEN 'defaulted'
      WHEN loan_standing_int = 2 THEN 'repaying'
      ELSE 'paid off'
    END as loan_standing
  FROM loans_held
),
trans97 AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS num_trans_97,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in_97,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'withdrawal') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out_97,
         MAX(balance) AS peak_balance_97
  FROM trans
  WHERE date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
profile AS (
  SELECT
    o.account_id,
    o.account_opened,
    o.gender,
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(o.birth_number,1,2) AS INTEGER) -
      (CASE
        WHEN substr(o.birth_number,3,2)||'-'||substr(o.birth_number,5,2) > '12-31' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
       END)
     ) + (CASE WHEN substr(o.birth_number,3,2) > '12' THEN -100 ELSE 0 END) AS age_96,
    COALESCE(c.num_cards, 0) AS num_cards,
    COALESCE(l.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
    COALESCE(l.loan_standing, 'no loan') AS loan_standing,
    COALESCE(t.num_trans_97, 0) AS num_trans_97,
    COALESCE(t.money_in_97, 0) AS money_in_97,
    COALESCE(t.money_out_97, 0) AS money_out_97,
    COALESCE(t.peak_balance_97, 0) AS peak_balance_97
  FROM owners o
  LEFT JOIN cards_held c ON o.account_id = c.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_standing_label l ON o.account_id = l.account_id
  LEFT JOIN trans97 t ON o.account_id = t.account_id
),
ranked_profile AS (
  SELECT *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance_97 DESC, account_id ASC) as peak_balance_rank
  FROM profile
)
SELECT
  account_id,
  account_opened,
  gender,
  age_96,
  num_cards,
  num_loans,
  loan_standing,
  num_trans_97,
  money_in_97,
  money_out_97,
  peak_balance_97,
  peak_balance_rank
FROM ranked_profile
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id
;

WITH classic_card_clients AS (

    WHERE card.type = 'classic'

),
district_accounts AS (

    FROM account a
),
client_district AS (
    SELECT
        da.district_id,
        ccc.client_id
    FROM classic_card_clients ccc
    JOIN district_accounts da ON ccc.account_id = da.account_id
),
ext_payments AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        t.account_id,
        t.amount,
        t.trans_id
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'withdrawal'
      AND t.operation = 'payment'
      AND (t.bank IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.bank) <> '')
      AND (t.account IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.account) <> '')
),
districts_base AS (
    SELECT district_id, name FROM district
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cd.client_id) AS num_clients
    FROM districts_base d
    LEFT JOIN client_district cd ON d.district_id = cd.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id
),
payments_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ep.account_id || '-' || ep.trans_id) AS num_external_payments,
        COALESCE(SUM(ep.amount),0) AS total_outgoing
    FROM districts_base d
    LEFT JOIN ext_payments ep ON d.district_id = ep.district_id
    LEFT JOIN account a ON ep.account_id = a.account_id
    LEFT JOIN disp disp_owner ON a.account_id = disp_owner.account_id AND disp_owner.type = 'OWNER'
    LEFT JOIN card ON disp_owner.disp_id = card.disp_id AND card.type = 'classic'
    GROUP BY d.district_id
)
SELECT
    db.name AS district_name,
    c.num_clients,
    p.num_external_payments,
    p.total_outgoing
FROM districts_base db
LEFT JOIN counts c ON db.district_id = c.district_id
LEFT JOIN payments_agg p ON db.district_id = p.district_id
ORDER BY p.total_outgoing DESC, db.name ASC;

others_qualifying AS (

WITH italian_gp_ids AS (

runners_up AS (

WITH italian_gp2017 AS (

q2_times AS (

WITH drivers_80s AS (

),
q3_laps AS (

    FROM qualifying q
    INNER JOIN drivers_80s d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d.driverId
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        CAST(SUM(COALESCE(q3_lap_count,0)) AS FLOAT) /

FROM drivers_80s d

WITH drivers_with_shared_forename AS (

target_drivers AS (

;

WITH french_gp_editions AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.date
    FROM races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE (c.name LIKE '%France%' OR c.location LIKE '%France%' OR c.country = 'France')
      AND strftime('%Y', r.date) >= '1990'
),
driver_fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT
        lt.raceId,
        lt.driverId,
        MIN(
            CAST(substr(lt.time, 1, instr(lt.time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
            CAST(substr(lt.time, instr(lt.time, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
        ) AS fastest_time_sec,
        MIN(lt.time) AS fastest_time_raw
    FROM lapTimes lt
    GROUP BY lt.raceId, lt.driverId
),
filtered_laps AS (
    SELECT
        e.date,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        fl.fastest_time_sec,
        fl.fastest_time_raw
    FROM french_gp_editions e
    LEFT JOIN driver_fastest_laps fl ON e.raceId = fl.raceId AND fl.fastest_time_sec > 90
    LEFT JOIN drivers d ON fl.driverId = d.driverId
)
SELECT
    date,
    forename,
    surname,
    CASE
        WHEN fastest_time_raw IS NOT NULL THEN
            printf('%d:%06.3f',
               CAST(fastest_time_sec AS INTEGER)/60,
               fastest_time_sec - 60*(CAST(fastest_time_sec AS INTEGER)/60)
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS fastest_lap_time
FROM filtered_laps
WHERE forename IS NOT NULL OR surname IS NOT NULL OR fastest_time_raw IS NULL
ORDER BY date ASC,
         surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC,
         forename COLLATE NOCASE ASC
;

WITH italian_drivers AS (

),
q3_times AS (

),
italian_q3 AS (

fastest_q3 AS (

WITH british_drivers AS (

),
q3_times AS (

),
min_q3 AS (

),
fastest_q3s AS (

    JOIN min_q3 mq3 ON CAST(REPLACE(qt.q3, ':', '') AS FLOAT) = mq3.min_q3_time

ORDER BY fq.q3 ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS num_drivers

WITH italian_gp_2017 AS (

q3_times AS (

WITH australian_drivers AS (

races_2002_2013 AS (

qualified_races AS (

season_pitstops AS (
