SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT qualifying.driverId) AS num_drivers
FROM qualifying
JOIN races ON qualifying.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE strftime('%Y', races.date) = '1995'
  AND qualifying.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
        -- q1 time is stored as milliseconds or as lap time string; check both cases
        (
          typeof(qualifying.q1) = 'integer' AND qualifying.q1 > 120000
        )
        OR
        (
          typeof(qualifying.q1) = 'text'
          AND (
                (length(qualifying.q1) = 8 AND 
                  (
                    -- Format: mm:ss.SSS
                    CAST(substr(qualifying.q1,1,2) AS INTEGER) > 2
                    OR (CAST(substr(qualifying.q1,1,2) AS INTEGER) = 2 AND 
                        CAST(substr(qualifying.q1,4,2) AS INTEGER) > 0)
                    OR (CAST(substr(qualifying.q1,1,2) AS INTEGER) = 2 AND 
                        CAST(substr(qualifying.q1,4,2) AS INTEGER) = 0 AND
                        CAST(substr(qualifying.q1,7,3) AS INTEGER) > 0)
                  )
                )
                OR
                (length(qualifying.q1)=7 AND  -- Format: m:ss.SSS
                  (
                    CAST(substr(qualifying.q1,1,1) AS INTEGER) > 2
                    OR (CAST(substr(qualifying.q1,1,1) AS INTEGER) = 2 AND 
                        CAST(substr(qualifying.q1,3,2) AS INTEGER) > 0)
                    OR (CAST(substr(qualifying.q1,1,1) AS INTEGER) = 2 AND 
                        CAST(substr(qualifying.q1,3,2) AS INTEGER) = 0 AND
                        CAST(substr(qualifying.q1,6,3) AS INTEGER) > 0)
                  )
                )
              )
          )
      )

WITH winners AS (
    SELECT
        d.driverId,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        d.nationality,
        d.dob,
        r.raceId,
        r.name AS race_name,
        r.date AS race_date
    FROM results res
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE res.position = '1'
),
oldest_winner AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        forename,
        surname,
        nationality,
        dob
    FROM winners
    GROUP BY driverId
    ORDER BY dob ASC, forename || ' ' || surname ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT
        w.driverId,
        w.race_name,
        w.race_date
    FROM winners w
    JOIN oldest_winner ow ON w.driverId = ow.driverId
    ORDER BY w.race_date ASC, w.race_name ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
career_starts AS (
    SELECT
        d.driverId,
        COUNT(*) AS num_starts
    FROM results res
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE d.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM oldest_winner)
    GROUP BY d.driverId
)
SELECT
    ow.forename || ' ' || ow.surname AS full_name,
    ow.nationality,
    fw.race_name AS first_win_race_name,
    fw.race_date AS first_win_race_date,
    cs.num_starts AS career_race_starts
FROM oldest_winner ow
JOIN first_win fw ON fw.driverId = ow.driverId
JOIN career_starts cs ON cs.driverId = ow.driverId
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS num_races_with_accidents

WITH italian_gp_2017 AS (

q2_times AS (

),
ordered_q2 AS (
    SELECT *,

)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name as constructor
FROM ordered_q2 o
JOIN drivers d ON o.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructors c ON o.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE o.rn = 2
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.surname, r.name AS race_name

WHERE r.year = 2017

SELECT d.number

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality

WITH chinese_gp_2000s AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.date, r.time, r.circuitId
    FROM races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE c.name LIKE '%China%' AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
),
local_times AS (
    SELECT 
        cgp.raceId,
        cgp.year,
        cgp.date,
        cgp.time,
        -- The Shanghai circuit is UTC+8; compute local time
        time(cgp.time, '+8 hours') AS local_start_time
    FROM chinese_gp_2000s cgp
),
earliest_race AS (
    SELECT raceId, year, local_start_time
    FROM local_times
    WHERE local_start_time = (
        SELECT MAX(local_start_time)
        FROM (
            SELECT MIN(local_start_time) AS local_start_time
            FROM local_times
        ) -- find all races with the earliest local start time
    )
    ORDER BY year DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
runner_up_gap AS (
    SELECT 
        r2.raceId, 
        r2.driverId, 
        r2.positionOrder, 
        r2.time AS time_gap
    FROM results r2
    WHERE r2.positionOrder = 2
)
SELECT
    e.year AS season_year,
    ru.time_gap AS runner_up_gap_to_winner
FROM earliest_race e
JOIN runner_up_gap ru ON e.raceId = ru.raceId
;

SELECT d.code

JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.code ASC;

SELECT
    r.year,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    res.time
FROM
    races r
JOIN
    circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN
    results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN
    drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE
    c.name = 'Circuit Gilles Villeneuve'
    AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017
    AND r.date IS NOT NULL
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND (
        -- Extract local hour for Montreal (UTC-4, but date can be arbitrary so using r.time - 4 hours for local)
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) - 4 <= 17
        OR (CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) - 4 + 24) % 24 <= 17
    )
    AND res.positionOrder = 1

races_with_start_datetime AS (

),
min_max_times AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(start_datetime) AS earliest_time,
        MAX(start_datetime) AS latest_time
    FROM races_with_start_datetime
),
earliest_circuits AS (
    SELECT
        c.circuitRef,
        r.start_datetime AS earliest_time
    FROM races_with_start_datetime r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    JOIN min_max_times m ON r.start_datetime = m.earliest_time
),
latest_circuits AS (
    SELECT
        c.circuitRef,
        r.start_datetime AS latest_time
    FROM races_with_start_datetime r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    JOIN min_max_times m ON r.start_datetime = m.latest_time
)
SELECT
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT e.circuitRef) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT l.circuitRef) AS latest_circuit_refs,
    CAST((strftime('%s', (SELECT latest_time FROM min_max_times)) - strftime('%s', (SELECT earliest_time FROM min_max_times))) AS INTEGER) AS start_time_gap_seconds
FROM earliest_circuits e
CROSS JOIN latest_circuits l
LIMIT 1;

WITH fall_events AS (
  SELECT event_id, name
  FROM event
  WHERE date >= '2019-09-01' AND date <= '2019-11-30'
),
womens_soccer_event AS (
  SELECT event_id
  FROM fall_events
  WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%women%' AND LOWER(name) LIKE '%soccer%'
  LIMIT 1
),
attendance_counts AS (
  SELECT
    fe.event_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS student_attendance
  FROM fall_events fe
  LEFT JOIN attendance a ON fe.event_id = a.event_id AND a.member_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fe.event_id
),
ws_count AS (
  SELECT student_attendance AS womens_soccer_attendance
  FROM attendance_counts
  WHERE event_id = (SELECT event_id FROM womens_soccer_event)
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(student_attendance * 1.0), 1) AS avg_attendance
  FROM attendance_counts
)
SELECT
  (SELECT womens_soccer_attendance FROM ws_count) AS womens_soccer_students,
  (SELECT avg_attendance FROM avg_count) AS avg_fall_students,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT womens_soccer_attendance FROM ws_count) > (SELECT avg_attendance FROM avg_count) THEN 'more'
    WHEN (SELECT womens_soccer_attendance FROM ws_count) < (SELECT avg_attendance FROM avg_count) THEN 'fewer'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS verdict
;

WITH college_departments AS (
    -- Find departments that offer at least one major in the College of Humanities and Social Sciences
    SELECT DISTINCT m.department
    FROM major m
    WHERE m.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
departments_majors AS (
    -- List majors offered by those departments, regardless of the majors' own college tag
    SELECT d.department, m.major
    FROM college_departments d
    JOIN major m ON m.department = d.department
),
majors_with_members AS (
    -- Find majors held by at least one member
    SELECT DISTINCT m.major
    FROM member mem
    JOIN major m ON mem.major = m.major
),
member_counts_per_major AS (
    -- For each major, count current members
    SELECT m.major, COUNT(mem.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM major m
    LEFT JOIN member mem ON mem.major = m.major
    GROUP BY m.major
),
departments_major_member_counts AS (
    -- For each department-major, bring in the member count
    SELECT
        dm.department,
        dm.major,
        COALESCE(mc.member_count, 0) AS member_count
    FROM departments_majors dm
    LEFT JOIN member_counts_per_major mc ON dm.major = mc.major
)
SELECT
    d.department AS department_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.major) AS majors_offered,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.major IS NOT NULL THEN m.major END) AS majors_with_members,
    ROUND(AVG(d.member_count), 2) AS avg_members_per_major_offered
FROM departments_major_member_counts d
LEFT JOIN majors_with_members m ON d.major = m.major
GROUP BY d.department
ORDER BY d.department;

WITH ece_college AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.major
  FROM member m
  JOIN major mj ON m.major = mj.major
  WHERE mj.college = (
    SELECT college
    FROM major
    WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering'
    LIMIT 1
  )
),
event_participants AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, m.major
  FROM event e
  JOIN member m ON e.member_id = m.member_id
  WHERE m.major IN (SELECT major FROM ece_college)
),
department_dues AS (
  SELECT
    mj.department,
    COALESCE(SUM(m.dues), 0) AS total_dues
  FROM major mj
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ep.member_id, ep.major
    FROM event_participants ep
  ) ep ON mj.major = ep.major
  LEFT JOIN member m ON ep.member_id = m.member_id AND m.major = mj.major
  WHERE mj.college = (
    SELECT college
    FROM major
    WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering'
    LIMIT 1
  )
  GROUP BY mj.department
)
SELECT
  department,
  total_dues
FROM department_dues
ORDER BY department;

WITH big_expenses AS (
    SELECT
        e.member_id,
        e.budget_id
    FROM
        expense e
    WHERE
        e.amount > 50
    GROUP BY
        e.member_id,
        e.budget_id
),
budget_usage AS (
    SELECT
        b.budget_id,
        b.amount AS budget_total,
        IFNULL(SUM(e.amount), 0) AS total_expensed,
        (b.amount - IFNULL(SUM(e.amount), 0)) AS remaining
    FROM
        budget b
    LEFT JOIN
        expense e ON b.budget_id = e.budget_id
    GROUP BY
        b.budget_id
),
member_budget_remaining AS (
    SELECT
        be.member_id,
        be.budget_id,
        bu.remaining
    FROM
        big_expenses be
    JOIN
        budget_usage bu ON be.budget_id = bu.budget_id
),
per_member_total AS (
    SELECT
        m.member_id,
        m.first_name,
        m.last_name,
        ROUND(SUM(mbr.remaining), 2) AS total_remaining
    FROM
        member m
    JOIN
        member_budget_remaining mbr ON m.member_id = mbr.member_id
    GROUP BY
        m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
)
SELECT
    first_name,
    last_name,
    total_remaining
FROM
    per_member_total
ORDER BY
    total_remaining DESC,
    last_name ASC,
    first_name ASC;

WITH football_event AS (

  FROM event
  WHERE name = 'football game'
  LIMIT 1

attending_members AS (

  FROM attendance a
  JOIN football_event fe ON a.event_id = fe.id
),
major_counts AS (

max_attendee_count AS (

  FROM event e
  JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.event_id
  JOIN expense ex ON b.event_id = ex.event_id AND b.category = ex.category
  WHERE (b.amount - ex.amount) < 0
    AND e.semester = (SELECT MAX(semester) FROM event)
),
purchases AS (
  SELECT ex.description
  FROM expense ex
  WHERE ex.event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM over_budget_events)
),
kinds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(value) AS kind
  FROM purchases,
       json_each('[' || REPLACE(REPLACE(description, ',', '","'), '"', '\"') || ']')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT kind) AS kinds_count
FROM kinds
WHERE kind <> '';

WITH attended_events AS (

water_expenses AS (

        SUM(expense.amount) AS water_total

)
SELECT

FROM attended_events ae
LEFT JOIN water_expenses we ON ae.event_id = we.event_id
ORDER BY ae.event_id

WITH budget_per_event AS (
    SELECT event_id, SUM(amount) AS total_budget
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY event_id
),
expense_per_event AS (
    SELECT event_id, SUM(amount) AS total_expense
    FROM expense
    GROUP BY event_id
),
event_status AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0) AS total_budget, COALESCE(x.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN budget_per_event b ON e.event_id = b.event_id
    LEFT JOIN expense_per_event x ON e.event_id = x.event_id
    WHERE e.closed_yn = 1
),
purchase_counts AS (
    SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count
    FROM income
    WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY event_id
),
eligible_events AS (
    SELECT es.event_id, es.event_name, COALESCE(pc.purchase_count, 0) AS purchase_count
    FROM event_status es
    LEFT JOIN purchase_counts pc ON es.event_id = pc.event_id
    WHERE es.total_expense <= es.total_budget
)
SELECT event_name
FROM eligible_events
ORDER BY purchase_count DESC, event_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

max_count AS (

  FROM event_member_counts
)
SELECT

  emc.member_count
FROM event_member_counts emc
JOIN max_count mc ON emc.member_count = mc.max_member_count;

member_kind_count AS (

  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN superhero sh ON hp.hero_id = sh.id
  JOIN publisher p ON sh.publisher_id = p.id
  WHERE p.name = 'Marvel Comics'
),
dc_powers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN superhero sh ON hp.hero_id = sh.id
  JOIN publisher p ON sh.publisher_id = p.id
  WHERE p.name = 'DC Comics'
),
unique_marvel_powers AS (
  SELECT mp.power_id
  FROM marvel_powers mp
  LEFT JOIN dc_powers dp ON mp.power_id = dp.power_id
  WHERE dp.power_id IS NULL
),
marvel_unique_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sh.id, sh.height_cm
  FROM superhero sh
  JOIN publisher p ON sh.publisher_id = p.id
  JOIN hero_power hp ON sh.id = hp.hero_id
  WHERE p.name = 'Marvel Comics'

SELECT AVG(height_cm) AS avg_height_cm
FROM marvel_unique_heroes;

WITH strength_heroes AS (
  SELECT sh.id AS hero_id
  FROM superhero sh
  JOIN hero_attribute ha ON sh.id = ha.hero_id
  JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
  WHERE a.attribute = 'Strength'
),
super_strength_power AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM superpower
  WHERE superpower = 'Super Strength'
),
powers_of_strength_heroes AS (
  SELECT hp.power_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  WHERE hp.hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM strength_heroes)
  GROUP BY hp.power_id
),
powers_of_non_strength_heroes AS (
  SELECT hp.power_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  WHERE hp.hero_id NOT IN (SELECT hero_id FROM strength_heroes)
  GROUP BY hp.power_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_powers_only_strength_heroes_have
FROM powers_of_strength_heroes psh
LEFT JOIN powers_of_non_strength_heroes pnsh ON psh.power_id = pnsh.power_id
WHERE pnsh.power_id IS NULL;

max_tenth_rank AS (

    ORDER BY rnk DESC

  )
),
tallest_heroes AS (

)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hero_power.superpower_id) AS num_unique_superpowers

)

WITH cryokinesis_heroes AS (

  JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id

),
shared_power_ids AS (

related_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hero_id

),
hero_power_counts AS (
  SELECT hp.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS num_powers

  WHERE hp.hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM related_heroes)
  GROUP BY hp.hero_id

SELECT ROUND(AVG(num_powers), 1) AS avg_superpowers
FROM hero_power_counts;

publisher_heros_eyecolors AS (

pub_heroes_with_race AS (

WITH cohort AS (

labs_with_platelet AS (

sle_at_exam AS (

WITH Relevant_Labs AS (
  SELECT
    Laboratory.patient_id,
    Laboratory.visit_id,
    MAX(CASE 
        WHEN Laboratory.test_name = 'LDH' 
          AND CAST(Laboratory.result AS FLOAT) > 600 
          AND CAST(Laboratory.result AS FLOAT) < 800
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_limited_LDH,
    MAX(CASE
        WHEN Laboratory.test_name = 'urine protein' THEN
          CASE
            -- Numeric mg/dL (e.g., 300), including plain numbers >= 300
            WHEN trim(lower(Laboratory.result)) GLOB '[0-9]*' AND CAST(Laboratory.result AS FLOAT) >= 300 THEN 1
            -- "at least 300", "at least 500", etc.
            WHEN lower(Laboratory.result) LIKE 'at least %'
              AND CAST(replace(lower(Laboratory.result), 'at least ', '') AS FLOAT) >= 300 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        ELSE 0 END) AS has_proteinuria
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Laboratory.test_name IN ('LDH', 'urine protein')
  GROUP BY Laboratory.patient_id, Laboratory.visit_id
),
Qualifying_Patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT patient_id
  FROM Relevant_Labs
  WHERE has_limited_LDH = 1 AND has_proteinuria = 1
),
Patient_Age AS (
  SELECT
    Patient.patient_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.birthdate) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE
          WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', Patient.birthdate) THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END AS completed_age_years
  FROM Patient
)
SELECT
  qp.patient_id,
  pa.completed_age_years
FROM Qualifying_Patients qp
JOIN Patient_Age pa ON pa.patient_id = qp.patient_id
ORDER BY qp.patient_id;

WITH total_patients AS (

patients_without_thrombosis AS (

WITH molecules_with_single_bond AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE type = 'single'
),
oxygen_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS molecule_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecules_with_single_bond)
  GROUP BY m.id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS avg_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule
FROM oxygen_counts;

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE is_carcinogenic = 1
),
single_bond_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS molecule_id,
    COUNT(b.id) AS single_bond_count
  FROM carcinogenic_molecules m
  JOIN bond b ON m.id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE b.type = 'single'
  GROUP BY m.id
)
SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS avg_single_bonds_per_molecule
FROM single_bond_counts
WHERE single_bond_count >= 1;

WITH non_carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE carcinogenic = 0
),
element_counts AS (
  SELECT atom.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
  FROM atom
  JOIN non_carcinogenic_molecules ON atom.molecule_id = non_carcinogenic_molecules.id
  GROUP BY atom.element
),
min_count AS (
  SELECT MIN(atom_count) AS min_atom_count FROM element_counts
)
SELECT element, atom_count
FROM element_counts
WHERE atom_count = (SELECT min_atom_count FROM min_count);

WITH single_bonds AS (
  SELECT * FROM bond WHERE type = 'single'
),
iodine_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.id
  FROM atom a
  JOIN single_bonds b ON a.id = b.atom1 OR a.id = b.atom2
  WHERE a.element = 'I'
),
sulfur_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.id
  FROM atom a
  JOIN single_bonds b ON a.id = b.atom1 OR a.id = b.atom2
  WHERE a.element = 'S'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iodine_atoms) AS distinct_iodine_atoms_in_single_bond,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sulfur_atoms) AS distinct_sulfur_atoms_in_single_bond;

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE carcinogenic = 1
),
fluorine_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'F'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(cm.id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM fluorine_bonds)) 
    / COUNT(*), 2
  ) AS percent_no_fluorine
FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
LEFT JOIN fluorine_bonds fb ON cm.id = fb.molecule_id
WHERE fb.molecule_id IS NULL;

WITH mol AS (
  SELECT id, name
  FROM molecule
  WHERE name = 'TR010'
),
common_bond AS (
  SELECT b.type, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM bond b
  JOIN mol m ON b.molecule_id = m.id
  GROUP BY b.type
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  cb.type AS most_common_bond_type,
  CASE WHEN m.carcinogenic = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM mol m
LEFT JOIN common_bond cb ON 1=1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS atom_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT m1.id
    FROM molecule m1
    JOIN bond b ON m1.id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON m1.id = a1.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = 'triple'
      AND (a1.element = 'P' OR a1.element = 'Br')
)

WITH molecules_with_single_bond AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE type = 'single'
),
atoms_in_qualified_molecules AS (
  SELECT a.*
  FROM atom a
  JOIN molecules_with_single_bond m
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)

  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /

    , 4
  ) AS percent_chlorine_atoms

WITH saturated_molecules AS (
    SELECT m.id

    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.molecule_id = m.id AND b.type <> '-'
    )
),
molecule_groups AS (
    SELECT

        CASE WHEN sm.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'saturated' ELSE 'unsaturated' END AS group_type,
        m.label

    LEFT JOIN saturated_molecules sm ON m.id = sm.id
)
SELECT
    group_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_minus_noncarcinogenic
FROM molecule_groups
GROUP BY group_type

;

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE type = 'triple'
),
carcinogenic_counts AS (

),
totals AS (

)

WITH rare_elements AS (

    FROM atom a
    GROUP BY a.element
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) = 1
),
carcinogenic_molecules_with_rare AS (
    SELECT m.id AS molecule_id, a.element
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE m.is_carcinogenic = 1
      AND a.element IN (SELECT element FROM rare_elements)
    GROUP BY m.id, a.element
),
atom_ids_for_rare_elements AS (
    SELECT a.id AS atom_id, a.molecule_id, a.element
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN carcinogenic_molecules_with_rare c
        ON a.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
       AND a.element = c.element
),
bonds_for_rare_atoms AS (
    SELECT
        afre.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS rare_element_bond_count
    FROM atom_ids_for_rare_elements afre
    JOIN bond b
        ON b.atom1_id = afre.atom_id OR b.atom2_id = afre.atom_id
    GROUP BY afre.molecule_id
)
SELECT
    molecule_id,
    rare_element_bond_count
FROM bonds_for_rare_atoms
ORDER BY molecule_id;

WITH carbon_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'C'
),
chlorine_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'Cl'
),
molecule_atoms AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
molecule_bonds AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
carbon_atom_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS carbon_atom_count
  FROM carbon_atoms
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
chlorine_atom_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS chlorine_atom_count
  FROM chlorine_atoms
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
carbon_touching_bonds AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS carbon_touching_bond_count
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a1 ON b.atom1 = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON b.atom2 = a2.atom_id
  WHERE (a1.element = 'C' OR a2.element = 'C') AND a1.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND a2.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
multiple_bonds AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS multiple_bond_count
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
all_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM carbon_atoms
)
SELECT
  m.molecule_id,
  m.carcinogenicity_label,
  COALESCE(ma.atom_count, 0) AS atom_count,
  COALESCE(mb.bond_count, 0) AS bond_count,
  COALESCE(cc.carbon_atom_count, 0) AS carbon_atom_count,
  COALESCE(clc.chlorine_atom_count, 0) AS chlorine_atom_count,
  COALESCE(ctb.carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS carbon_touching_bond_count,
  COALESCE(mub.multiple_bond_count, 0) AS multiple_bond_count,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    ORDER BY
      COALESCE(ctb.carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) DESC,
      COALESCE(ma.atom_count, 0) DESC,
      m.molecule_id ASC
  ) AS rank_position
FROM all_molecules am
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = am.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN molecule_atoms ma ON m.molecule_id = ma.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN molecule_bonds mb ON m.molecule_id = mb.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN carbon_atom_counts cc ON m.molecule_id = cc.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN chlorine_atom_counts clc ON m.molecule_id = clc.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN carbon_touching_bonds ctb ON m.molecule_id = ctb.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN multiple_bonds mub ON m.molecule_id = mub.molecule_id
ORDER BY
  carbon_touching_bond_count DESC,
  atom_count DESC,
  m.molecule_id ASC
;

    bond.molecule = (

        WHERE element = 'Y'
        LIMIT 1
    )
)
;

    molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.id

WITH single_double_bonds AS (
  SELECT
    b.kind AS bond_kind_symbol,
    COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
      WHEN m1.atom_id < m2.atom_id 
      THEN m1.element || '-' || m2.element
      ELSE m2.element || '-' || m1.element
    END) AS num_element_pairs
  FROM molecule AS mol
  JOIN atom AS m1 ON mol.molecule_id = m1.molecule_id
  JOIN bond AS b ON m1.atom_id = b.atom1_id
  JOIN atom AS m2 ON b.atom2_id = m2.atom_id
  WHERE mol.molecule_name = 'TR377'
    AND b.kind IN ('single', 'double')
  GROUP BY b.kind
)
SELECT
  sdb.bond_kind_symbol,
  sdb.num_bonds,
  sdb.num_element_pairs,
  mol.carcinogenicity_label
FROM single_double_bonds sdb
CROSS JOIN molecule mol
WHERE mol.molecule_name = 'TR377'
ORDER BY sdb.num_bonds DESC, sdb.bond_kind_symbol ASC;

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.carcinogenic = 0
  AND a.type = 'metal'
  AND b.type = 'single'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  a.element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(*) AS fully_saturated_atom_count
FROM
  atom a
JOIN
  bond b ON a.id = b.atom1 OR a.id = b.atom2
GROUP BY
  a.id
HAVING
  MIN(b.type) = 1
  AND MAX(b.type) = 1
  AND COUNT(b.id) > 0
-- The above ensures only atoms with at least one bond and ALL bonds are single (type=1)
-- Now group by element symbol for final count
-- (wrap as subquery to aggregate by element)
-- (SQLite does not support aliases in HAVING, keep logic in place)
) 
SELECT
  element_symbol, COUNT(*) AS saturated_atoms
FROM (
  SELECT
    a.element AS element_symbol
  FROM
    atom a
  JOIN
    bond b ON a.id = b.atom1 OR a.id = b.atom2
  GROUP BY
    a.id
  HAVING
    MIN(b.type) = 1
    AND MAX(b.type) = 1
    AND COUNT(b.id) > 0
)
GROUP BY
  element_symbol
ORDER BY
  element_symbol ASC;

WITH triple_bond_elements AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.element, c.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a ON (b.atom1 = a.id OR b.atom2 = a.id)
  JOIN connected c ON a.id = c.atom_id
  WHERE b.order = 3
)
SELECT
  element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM triple_bond_elements
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

SELECT

  COUNT(DISTINCT atom.id) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.id
JOIN bond ON (bond.atom1_id = atom.id OR bond.atom2_id = atom.id)
WHERE molecule.name = 'TR397'
GROUP BY atom.element
ORDER BY atom.element ASC;
